Key Features & Advantages

Superior Salt-Spray Resistance

Withstands over 1,000 hours of continuous salt-spray testing without rusting.

Sealed Needle Bearings

Prevents sea water and brine from entering critical internal gear shafts.

Heavy-Duty Galvanized Hooks

Drop-forged alloy steel hooks with stainless steel safety latch pins.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13157 Standard

Hand-powered cranes and hoists standard.

CE & ISO Marine Verified

Factory proof-tested with certificate.

Product Overview

Engineered explicitly for offshore drilling rigs, commercial marine vessels, coastal terminals, and oilfield operations, the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Hoist provides reliable service in high-salinity and extreme humidity environments.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist are available?

The Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist is available in 6 models: EPC-M05, EPC-M10, EPC-M20, EPC-M30, EPC-M50, EPC-M100. Capacity (Tons) ranges from 0.5 Ton to 10.0 Ton. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist cover?

The Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist covers 0.5t - 20t.

Which standard does the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist comply with?

The Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist is manufactured to EN 13157.

What corrosion Protection does the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist's corrosion Protection: Multi-Layer Marine Dacromet & Epoxy Coating.

What load Chain does the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist's load Chain: Grade 80 Extra Galvanized Alloy Chain (EN 818-7).

What braking System does the Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Marine Anti-Corrosion Chain Hoist's braking System: Twin Pawl Enclosed Corrosion-Protected Brake.
